_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior vinyl (PVC) siding repaint. Context prefix VNRP (Vinyl RePaint) — no collision with existing prefixes (WSRP is wood siding repaint). DRAMATICALLY simpler than wood siding repaint: single substrate state (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT), no DSD gradient, no RRP gate, no stain-blocking, adhesion primer always required. LRV class replaces DSD as the dominant configuration variable (material selection, not labor). QT2-QT3 only — vinyl is not a fine-finish substrate. Spray primary with no backbrushing (non-porous PVC).

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface
paintable_items.notes: REUSED from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT and SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC. Same physical item (siding field), vinyl repaint context. Add SF_SIDING_VINYL_EXT_RP to used_in array.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, WSRP. VNRP is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_VNRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_VNRP_WASH_PRESSURE, TSK_VNRP_SCUFF_SAND, TSK_VNRP_PRIME_ADHESION_SPRAY, TSK_VNRP_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_VNRP_DETAIL_BRUSH, TSK_VNRP_MASK_WINDOWS, TSK_VNRP_CAULK_ASSESS

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape, hardscape, HVAC, light fixtures, window/door masking (spray method). Warranty void acknowledgment gate. LRV verification gate.
Pressure wash — mandatory first production step. Alkaline cleaner, downward spray pattern, 500-1000 PSI. Removes dirt, mildew, chalk residue. 24-48 hour dry time before priming.
Surface preparation — light scuff sand or liquid sander for adhesion tooth. MINIMAL compared to wood siding repaint — no scraping, no feather-sanding, no wood fiber treatment. PCA P14 Level 2.
Adhesion primer (STIX class) spray application. Single coat, full coverage — no spot prime option. Solvent-attack chemical bond to PVC. ALWAYS required, no state-dependent branching.
First finish coat — 100% acrylic latex exterior, spray application. QT2 = single finish coat (this is the only finish module). QT3 = first of two finish coats.
Second finish coat. QT3 only — QT2 uses single finish coat. No interstage module between coats (vinyl surface does not require intercoat sanding).
Brush detail at J-channels, under-sill channels, corner transitions, and trim cut-in. QT3 only — primary labor differentiator between tiers. Rate: 125-175 SF/hr.
Caulk assessment and replacement at siding-to-trim joints. QT3 only. Siliconized acrylic paintable caulk. LF-based.
Protection teardown, site cleanup, tool cleaning. No RRP waste disposal (vinyl is never lead-painted).

quality_tier.notes: QT4/QT5 excluded — vinyl is not a fine-finish substrate. QT2 = economy (wash, adhesion prime, single finish coat). QT3 = standard (wash with TSP, adhesion prime, two finish coats, J-channel detail, caulk assessment). Per KD-004.

application_method.notes: Spray is primary method for vinyl siding field. NO backbrushing — vinyl is non-porous PVC, coating does not absorb. Brush_roll for detail areas or when spray is not feasible (wind, neighbor proximity). Per KD-010.

lrv_class.notes: NEW enum type — unique to vinyl siding. Drives material selection (standard vs IR-reflective products) and color approval gate. LRV <35 = HARD STOP, not a configuration option. standard_55+ = any 100% acrylic exterior latex. ir_reflective_35-55 = IR-reflective pigment products ONLY (VinylSafe, Colors for Vinyl). Per KD-003.

sheen.notes: Limited to flat and satin for exterior vinyl siding. Semi-gloss uncommon on siding field (typically reserved for trim). Satin is most common default.

phase.notes: No 'interstage' phase — vinyl does not require intercoat sanding. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for siding field tasks. LF for caulk work and trim masking. EA for protection items and per-project tasks. FIXED for tool cleaning and administrative gates.

substrate_state.notes: SINGLE input state — vinyl always has factory PVC finish intact. No DSD gradient. No chalking/failing/peeling/weathered states (those are wood-specific deterioration). Output state varies by sheen selection. All states are existing in controlled_enums.json.

product_role.notes: Primer (adhesion) and finish only. No sealer/clear/stain/specialty needed for vinyl siding repaint.

protection_level.notes: Repaint on occupied homes — spray method requires full_cover/full_mask on windows, doors, and adjacent trim.

surface_ids.notes: Primary surface and most adjacent surfaces exist in id_registry. 'fascia' appears in research adjacency_analysis but is NOT in registry — resolved to ext_trim_frieze (which covers the frieze/fascia junction zone). All adjacent surfaces are separate specs — no edge work on siding field.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — NC standard 100% acrylic exterior finish. Same binder class but different context (NC vs repaint). Consider reuse for QT2/QT3 standard finish.
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — NC bonding primer for smooth substrates. Different mechanism — STIX-class adhesion primer uses solvent attack on PVC, distinct from standard bonding primers.

proposed_systems.name: Vinyl Adhesion Primer (STIX Class)
proposed_systems.notes: ALWAYS required for vinyl siding. STIX-class high-solids adhesion primer that chemically bonds to PVC via solvent attack. Products: Insl-X STIX SXA-110, Benjamin Moore Fresh Start 023. Single coat, full coverage spray. Standard exterior primers are NOT acceptable substitutes. Coverage: 300-400 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Standard 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior (LRV 55+)
proposed_systems.notes: Standard 100% acrylic latex exterior paint. Alkyd/oil/hybrid PROHIBITED on vinyl. QT2 = economy grade (SW A-100, BM Ben), single coat. QT3 = mid-grade (SW SuperPaint, BM Regal Select), two coats. Coverage: 350-450 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: IR-Reflective 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior (LRV 35-55)
proposed_systems.notes: IR-reflective pigment products for colors LRV 35-55. Products: SW VinylSafe colors, BM Colors for Vinyl. Same 100% acrylic binder, special pigment technology reflects near-infrared radiation. Higher material cost but identical labor/coverage rates. MANDATORY for any color LRV 35-55 — standard products will cause thermal warping.

material_system_prefix.notes: 1 mandatory adhesion primer + 2 LRV-class-driven finish systems. MUCH simpler than wood siding repaint (5 state-driven primers + 2 finish systems). Primer is state-independent (always required). Finish selection driven by lrv_class, not substrate_state. Binder LOCKED to 100% acrylic latex — alkyd/oil/hybrid prohibited.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 517 (Vinyl Siding Field)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard tip for spray on vinyl siding. Same as wood siding spray tip.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 3/8 inch Nap (Brush_Roll Method)
proposed_consumables.notes: For brush_roll application method. 3/8 inch nap for smooth vinyl surface (shorter than 3/4 inch nap for wood).

proposed_consumables.name: 220-Grit Sandpaper (Scuff Sand)
proposed_consumables.notes: For light scuff sanding to create adhesion tooth on smooth vinyl PVC. May also use liquid sander (Krud Kutter) as alternative.

proposed_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
proposed_consumables.notes: Chemical scuff alternative to mechanical sanding on vinyl. Krud Kutter or equivalent. Applied by wipe or spray, creates adhesion tooth without physical abrasion.

proposed_consumables.name: Masking Paper 12 inch Roll (Window/Door Masking)
proposed_consumables.notes: For window and door masking during spray operations.

proposed_consumables.name: Siliconized Acrylic Paintable Caulk
proposed_consumables.notes: For siding-to-trim joint caulk replacement (QT3 only). Siliconized acrylic — vinyl has low joint movement, polyurethane not required.

proposed_consumables.name: 60-Mesh Spray Filter (Black) for Latex
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard 60-mesh filter for latex coatings through airless equipment.

proposed_consumables.name: Red Stucco Poly Tape (7 mil, 30-day UV)
proposed_consumables.notes: For extended spray masking on exterior. Higher adhesion than blue tape on smooth surfaces.

proposed_configurations.description: Adhesion prime (1 coat) + 1 finish coat — economy vinyl repaint
proposed_configurations.notes: Minimum viable vinyl repaint. Adhesion primer is mandatory (not optional like spot prime on sound wood). Single finish coat. Total: 2 coating passes.

proposed_configurations.description: Adhesion prime (1 coat) + 2 finish coats — standard vinyl repaint
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard residential repaint. Adhesion primer + two finish coats for better DFT and durability. J-channel detail coat included. Total: 3 coating passes + detail.

proposed_profiles.description: Adhesion primer (STIX class) on smooth vinyl PVC — 300-400 SF/gal. Full coverage single coat. Slightly lower coverage on UV-chalked vinyl (use 300 SF/gal).
100% acrylic latex finish on primed vinyl — 350-450 SF/gal per coat. Better coverage than wood siding (uniform factory texture, non-porous surface).

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Window/door protection during siding spray is this spec's responsibility when those surfaces do not have their own active spec. Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate spec scopes. No cross-spec flags needed. No RRP gate (vinyl is never lead-painted). LRV hard stop (LRV <35) is a project-level gate handled within this spec.

existing_modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS — ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50 (existing, shared across exterior specs)

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks only. QT2 = economy (less care, minimal J-channel detail). QT3 = baseline standard.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Standard QT modifier pattern. No QT4/QT5 — vinyl is not a fine-finish substrate.

factor_modifiers.notes: ONLY 2 modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS (existing, shared) + FAC_VNRP_QT (proposed). No DSD modifier (vinyl has no deterioration gradient). No RRP modifier (vinyl is never lead-painted). No siding_profile modifier (vinyl siding is effectively always lap profile — board_and_batten vinyl is rare and handled as a minor effective area adjustment in production rates, not a separate modifier). This is dramatically simpler than wood siding repaint (4 modifiers: access + DSD + siding_profile + QT + RRP gate).

materials_json.vinyl_specific: Binder LOCKED to 100% acrylic latex. Alkyd/oil/hybrid PROHIBITED. Adhesion primer (STIX class) is MANDATORY — standard exterior primers fail on vinyl.

sop_modules_json.vinyl_specific: Include WARRANTY VOID GATE and LRV VERIFICATION GATE as administrative tasks before production begins.

production_json.vinyl_specific: Access modifier is the ONLY multiplicative labor modifier. No DSD stacking. lrv_class does NOT change labor rates.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → finish → cleanup (no interstage for vinyl)
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_VNRP_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_SIDING_FIELD MUST be used exactly as registered (existing ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums
RULE 12 (VINYL-SPECIFIC): Adhesion primer is ALWAYS required — no conditional logic, no spot prime option. Every variant includes primer module.
RULE 13 (VINYL-SPECIFIC): lrv_class drives MATERIAL selection only, NOT labor rates. SYS_VNRP_FINISH_STANDARD for standard_55+, SYS_VNRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE for ir_reflective_35-55.
RULE 14 (VINYL-SPECIFIC): LRV <35 is a HARD STOP. Do NOT include in any configuration dimension, variant, or production rate table. Estimation engine must reject.
RULE 15 (VINYL-SPECIFIC): Binder locked to 100% acrylic latex. No alkyd, no oil, no hybrid in ANY material system. Enforced at material specification level.
